blocks.text: LA PAZ, Bolivia — Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz declared a state of emergency on Saturday to free up resources to deal with the impact of the El Niño weather phenomenon, which is wreaking havoc around the world. The decree also calls for deploying more rescue teams in hard-hit areas as Bolivia grapples with both flooding and drought because of El Niño, Paz said in an address to the nation. “This will be a phenomenon that will have very severe impacts in terms of drought and floods, and we need the cooperation of all institutions,” Paz said.
